checks.action_units_and_shapes: Seven dimensions; per-dimension minimum and maximum recorded.
checks.checkpoint_provenance: checkpoint_tree in provenance.json for SmolVLA and pi0.5.
checks.condition_smoke: NATIVE, R22, R25, R52, R55 once each on one non-confirmation identity (seeds 790011, 790012; state official0).
checks.dependency_provenance: Installed package list in provenance.json for all three environments.
checks.generated_state_hashes: 200 serialized states with SHA-256 in state_manifest.json.
checks.implementation_received_d: SmolVLA denoise count equals generations x d. pi0.5 num_steps observed at the sampler call, and same noise gives different chunks across d=2, 5, 10.
checks.matched_reset_first_action_hashes: Same reset, noise and d give identical first actions: R22 = R52, R25 = R55.
checks.native_parity: Four suites, ten tasks, ten episodes per task, per model: 400 per model.
checks.official_normalization: norm_stats.json hash, plus loaded Unnormalize statistics equal to the file and quantile mode on.
checks.protocol_and_schedule_binding: Release bound to protocol hash; the confirmation release must list the exact schedule file; deferred cohorts refused.
checks.reset_mismatch_termination: Negative control on the real simulator: a wrong reference stops before any policy query.
checks.reset_reuse: Settled state hash identical across all conditions of one identity.
checks.timing: 100 warm-up + 100 measured calls per d; per-generation and per-rollout timing.
checks.video_inspection: Every parity video readable, not blank, not frozen; contact sheet per task inspected by a person.

counted_run: The first execution of run_preflight_v2.sh that passes its entry gates. A failure stays failed; a later attempt needs a new run ID and a recorded reason.
exclusions: The earlier invalid pi0.5 campaign of 160 attempts is permanently excluded and is never relabelled or reused.
The stale-observation 20/40 versus 28/40 result and its contribution claim are excluded unless the original journals are recovered and audited.
The submitted NeurIPS RoboPAD PDF stays unchanged.

verdict_rule.PREFLIGHT_FAILED: Any mechanical check fails or evidence is missing, or Alba's parity criterion or the video inspection fails.
verdict_rule.PREFLIGHT_PASSED: Every mechanical check passes, parity meets Alba's criterion and the videos pass inspection.
verdict_rule.note: preflight_verdict.py alone can report only failure, or mechanical checks passed awaiting review.
